string.text: Decreases bullet dispersion, which improves accuracy.
Higher rifling twist rate increases muzzle velocity and reduces bullet dispersion.
Barrel replacement for APB pistol allows a suppressor to be installed.
Reduces the play of the magazine inside the pistol grip, reduces the probability of feeding issues making the gun more reliable.
Modified rate reducer along with a stiffer return spring allows to increase rate of fire.
Reduces overall weight of the gun by replacing the standard magazine with a lightweight counterpart.
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Burst fire limiter restricts the burst to three rounds. In three-round burst mode the gun is more controllable, thus ammo needed for each target is reduced.
Grip panels made to fit the shooter's preferences. New panels allow for better grip and more comfortable shooting.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Reduces the probability of malfunctions related to ejecting an empty case from the firearm. Improves reliability.
Improves obturation due to tighter lock-up, which in turn increases muzzle velocity.
Balanced slide decreases muzzle climb and felt recoil.
Application of a protective coating to the internal parts significantly reduces wear.
Exact fit of the slide and its internal parts reduces play, which improves accuracy.
Reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts.
Parts made of refractory metals that are extraordinarily resistant to heat and wear improve durability.
